title: STORYBOARD ARTIST
description:
We are seeking a creative and visually intuitive Storyboard Artist to translate scripts and narrative ideas into clear, dynamic sequence panels. In this role, you will define the visual pacing, staging, shot composition, and character performance to lay the foundation for our production pipeline.



Key Responsibilities



Translating script pages and director notes into rough-to-clean sequential storyboards.



Framing compositions with a strong focus on staging, dynamic camera angles, and visual rhythm.



Communicating character emotion, action, and timing effectively through gesture and pose.



Collaborating with directors, leads, and animatic editors to refine story beats and continuity.



Adapting quickly to feedback and making iterative drawing revisions under tight timelines.



Requirements & Qualifications



Proficiency in digital boarding software (Toon Boom Storyboard Pro, Photoshop, or TVPaint).



Strong foundations in drawing, anatomy, perspective, sequential storytelling, and cinematography.



Ability to capture clear character acting and readable silhouettes in quick sketches.



Understanding of camera motion, lens choices, and editing transitions.



How to Apply

title: Customer Support Specialist – Shopify Dropshipping | Long-Term
description:
We are looking for an experienced Customer Support Specialist to join our growing e-commerce business long-term.



We operate multiple Shopify stores across international markets and are specifically looking for someone who already understands Shopify dropshipping customer support.



If you have worked with dropshipping stores before, you probably know the situations we deal with every day: shipping delays, tracking issues, supplier problems, wrong items, out-of-stock products, replacements, returns, refunds, and customers who sometimes require a little more patience and problem-solving.



You don't need to be a manager or know everything from day one. We have clear SOPs and will train you on our specific workflows.



What matters most is that you already understand e-commerce/dropshipping support, communicate well, learn quickly, and can think for yourself.



What you'll be doing



Your day-to-day work will include:



* Responding to customer
s

* Managing customer support through Gorgias

* Checking and managing orders in Shopify

* Handling shipping and tracking issues

* Communicating order issues with our fulfillment team

* Handling cancellations, replacements, returns, and refunds

* Finding reasonable solutions when something goes wrong

* Following up on unresolved customer cases

* Helping keep customers happy without unnecessarily refunding orders

* Flagging recurring problems when you notice them



We don't expect you to solve every situation independently from day one. You'll learn our policies, suppliers, workflows, and way of working during onboarding.



Who we're looking for



We're especially interested in someone who has:



* Previous customer support experience for Shopify dropshipping stores

* Experience using Shopify

* Experience with Gorgias, Re:amaze, Zendesk, or similar support platforms

* Good written English

* Experience handling shipping delays, tracking issues, refunds, replacements, and difficult customers

* Good judgment and common sense

* The ability to work independently once trained

* Reliable availability and communication



Experience with international dropshipping stores, suppliers, fulfillment agents, 17TRACK, ParcelPanel, PayPal disputes, or chargebacks is a strong plus.



We're looking for someone who wants to stay with us long-term and grow together with the business.



How to Apply



Start your application with the word DIAMOND so we know you read the full job post.



Please answer the following questions:



1. Tell me about your previous dropshipping experience.



What type of stores did you work with, what were your responsibilities, and how long did you work there?



2. Tell me about a difficult customer situation you personally handled.



What happened, and what did you do?



3. A customer wants a full refund because their order is delayed, but the package is still in transit. How would you handle it?



4. Which platforms and tools have you used?



5. What is your weekly availability?



Please also include:



* (optional) Your resume/CV

* A screenshot of your current internet speed



We're not looking for the person with the longest resume. We're looking for someone reliable who understands dropshipping, communicates well, learns quickly, and wants to become a long-term part of the team.

title: APPOINTMENT SETTER / CREATOR
description:
APPOINTMENT SETTER / CREATOR

UGC • Content Creation • Lead Generation • Social Commerce

30-Day Paid Trial: $900 Guaranteed + Uncapped Commission

Growth Path: Social Commerce Sales Manager



We are building a new social commerce division focused on helping creators, aspiring entrepreneurs and social-media-native people launch their own skincare businesses.

We are looking for our first Appointment Setter / Creator.

This is NOT a traditional Virtual Assistant position.

It is NOT a cold-calling job.

And it is not a job where you sit around waiting for someone to tell you what to do.

We are looking for someone who can create content, find the right people, start conversations and turn interest into qualified sales appointments.

If you are comfortable in front of a camera, understand social media and enjoy talking to people, this could be a very good opportunity.



WHAT WE DO

We help people launch their own private-label skincare business without having to invest thousands of dollars into inventory, manufacturing or product development.

We build the infrastructure for them.

Depending on the package, we provide:

? A ready-to-sell Shopify store

? 5, 15 or 30 skincare products

? Their own private skincare brand

? Product branding and design

? High-quality European-made skincare products

? Sales strategy

? Personal sales mentoring

? Ongoing support

Our packages are:

$300 — 5 products

$500 — 15 products

$800 — 30 products

And we stand behind the system with a:

90-DAY MONEY-BACK GUARANTEE

If a client follows our system and recommendations and does not earn back their investment in our service within 90 days, we refund the service fee.

Our objective is not simply to sell a Shopify store.

We want our clients to build businesses that actually generate sales.



YOUR ROLE

Your job is simple to understand:

Find the right people ? start conversations ? create interest ? qualify them ? book the appointment.

You will be the first human interaction many potential customers have with our company.

You will work primarily through social media.

You will:

? Find potential customers in relevant
 groups and social communities

? Post useful and engaging content

? Create UGC-style videos for TikTok, Instagram,
 and other platforms

? Reply to comments

? Start conversations through DM

? Identify people who are genuinely interested in starting an online business

? Explain the opportunity at a basic level

? Qualify potential customers

? Book Google Meet appointments

? Follow up with interested prospects

? Occasionally present the opportunity yourself on Google Meet

? Pass qualified prospects to the sales process

You will receive complete training on our products, offer, sales process, communication and content strategy.

You don't need to know our system when you start.

You need to be willing to learn it.



YOU ARE ALSO A CREATOR

This is a key part of the role.

We don't want someone simply copying advertisements into
 groups.

We want someone who understands how people actually consume content.

You should be able to create simple, authentic videos that people want to watch.

For example:

“Why UGC creators should consider building their own brand.”

“How I would start a skincare business without buying inventory.”

“Why having an audience is more valuable than having 10,000 followers.”

“How creators can make money without waiting for brands to hire them.”

You don't need expensive equipment.

You don't need a huge following.

You don't need to be a professional influencer.

You need to be comfortable talking to a camera and communicating naturally.

Your personality matters more than perfect production.



OUR TARGET AUDIENCE

Our service is designed for people who want to build a social-commerce-based skincare business with low entry barriers and strong support.

We primarily work with:

? UGC creators and content creators who want to monetize their audience and move beyond brand collaborations

? Aspiring entrepreneurs who want to start an online business without holding inventory or dealing with manufacturing

? Social-media-native individuals who are comfortable on camera and understand how online attention works

? People interested in beauty, skincare and wellness industries

? Young mothers or individuals seeking flexible, location-independent income

? Micro-influencers and emerging creators looking to build their own brand instead of promoting others

? Individuals who want to launch a product-based business with a ready-made system and support structure

In short, we help people who already understand or are actively involved in social media, and who want to turn that into a real business opportunity.



THE COMMISSION

This position has a 30-day paid trial period.

During the first 30 days:

$900 guaranteed compensation

PLUS:

Uncapped commission

$100 for every $300 package sold

$200 for every $500 package sold

$300 for every $800 package sold

There is no commission ceiling.

The more qualified customers you generate, the more you earn.

The $900 is guaranteed during the paid trial period, so you have the opportunity to learn the business, understand the market and prove yourself without taking all the risk.



AFTER THE TRIAL

If we both decide that we're a good fit, you move into the permanent role with an increased performance-based compensation structure.

And there is a clear growth path.

Creator-Salesperson

?

Senior Creator-Salesperson

?

Social Commerce Sales Manager

Our goal is to build a sales team around this model.

As we grow, the person who proves that they can consistently generate leads, create content and convert conversations into appointments will have the opportunity to lead other appointment setters and creators.

We want to build this position into a real management role, not keep you doing the same thing forever.



WHAT WE CARE ABOUT MORE THAN EXPERIENCE

You don't need a university degree.

You don't need 10 years of sales experience.

You don't even need traditional sales experience if you can demonstrate the right personality and skills.

We care about:

Communication

Can you talk naturally to people?

Confidence

Can you appear on camera without freezing?

Curiosity

Do you actually want to understand people and what makes them buy?

Initiative

Can you find opportunities without being given a checklist every morning?

Consistency

Can you create content and start conversations every day?

Sales instinct

Can you recognize when someone is genuinely interested?

Learning ability

Can you take feedback and improve quickly?



ONE THING WE DON'T WANT

Someone who waits for instructions.

We will give you:

? Training

? Scripts

? Content ideas

? Product information

? Sales materials

? Our proven process

? Support

But we expect you to think.

If you discover a
 group nobody else is using — tell us.

If you find a content format that generates conversations — make more of it.

If you discover a better way to reach UGC creators — test it.

If you think something in our sales process can be improved — speak up.

We are looking for someone who eventually thinks like a Sales Manager, not someone who needs to be managed every minute.



WHY SKINCARE?

Because skincare is one of the strongest categories for social commerce.

People already buy it.

Creators already talk about it.

UGC works naturally with it.

And our products are not random marketplace products.

We work with high-quality European manufacturing and skincare formulas that use a strong percentage of natural ingredients.

This makes the offer much easier to communicate through authentic creator content.



WHY THIS ROLE COULD BE INTERESTING FOR YOU

You won't simply be selling someone else's product.

You will learn:

? Social selling

? Lead generation

? Appointment setting

? Content marketing

? UGC

? Personal branding

? Social commerce

? Sales psychology

? Online business development

These are skills you can use anywhere in the future.

And if you perform well, you can grow into a management position within the company.



HOW TO APPLY

Read this part carefully.

Please do NOT send:

“Hi, I'm interested.”

Generic applications will be ignored.

Start your application with:

CREATOR

Then answer these 4 questions:

1. Have you created content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube or
? What type of content?

2. Are you comfortable appearing on camera and speaking naturally to an audience?

3. Have you ever sold something, generated leads or convinced someone to take an action? Tell us briefly about it.

4. Why does social commerce and building an online business interest you?

Please also include:

? Examples of your content, if available

? Your availability for the next 30 days



The first 30 days are a paid trial.

$900 guaranteed + uncapped commission.

If you prove that you can create content, generate conversations and book qualified appointments, there is a real opportunity to grow with us.

We are looking for our first Creator-Salesperson.

And if you are good at this, the goal is not for you to remain an appointment setter.

The goal is for you to eventually become the person leading the sales team.

Start your application with CREATOR.

title: UGC • Content Creation • Lead Generation • Social Commerce 30-Day Paid Trial: $900 Guaranteed + Uncapped Commission
description:
APPOINTMENT SETTER / CREATOR

UGC • Content Creation • Lead Generation • Social Commerce

30-Day Paid Trial: $900 Guaranteed + Uncapped Commission

Growth Path: Social Commerce Sales Manager



We are building a new social commerce division focused on helping creators, aspiring entrepreneurs and social-media-native people launch their own skincare businesses.

We are looking for our first Appointment Setter / Creator.

This is NOT a traditional Virtual Assistant position.

It is NOT a cold-calling job.

And it is not a job where you sit around waiting for someone to tell you what to do.

We are looking for someone who can create content, find the right people, start conversations and turn interest into qualified sales appointments.

If you are comfortable in front of a camera, understand social media and enjoy talking to people, this could be a very good opportunity.



WHAT WE DO

We help people launch their own private-label skincare business without having to invest thousands of dollars into inventory, manufacturing or product development.

We build the infrastructure for them.

Depending on the package, we provide:

? A ready-to-sell Shopify store

? 5, 15 or 30 skincare products

? Their own private skincare brand

? Product branding and design

? High-quality European-made skincare products

? Sales strategy

? Personal sales mentoring

? Ongoing support

Our packages are:

$300 — 5 products

$500 — 15 products

$800 — 30 products

And we stand behind the system with a:

90-DAY MONEY-BACK GUARANTEE

If a client follows our system and recommendations and does not earn back their investment in our service within 90 days, we refund the service fee.

Our objective is not simply to sell a Shopify store.

We want our clients to build businesses that actually generate sales.



YOUR ROLE

Your job is simple to understand:

Find the right people ? start conversations ? create interest ? qualify them ? book the appointment.

You will be the first human interaction many potential customers have with our company.

You will work primarily through social media.

You will:

? Find potential customers in relevant
 groups and social communities

? Post useful and engaging content

? Create UGC-style videos for TikTok, Instagram,
 and other platforms

? Reply to comments

? Start conversations through DM

? Identify people who are genuinely interested in starting an online business

? Explain the opportunity at a basic level

? Qualify potential customers

? Book Google Meet appointments

? Follow up with interested prospects

? Occasionally present the opportunity yourself on Google Meet

? Pass qualified prospects to the sales process

You will receive complete training on our products, offer, sales process, communication and content strategy.

You don't need to know our system when you start.

You need to be willing to learn it.



YOU ARE ALSO A CREATOR

This is a key part of the role.

We don't want someone simply copying advertisements into
 groups.

We want someone who understands how people actually consume content.

You should be able to create simple, authentic videos that people want to watch.

For example:

“Why UGC creators should consider building their own brand.”

“How I would start a skincare business without buying inventory.”

“Why having an audience is more valuable than having 10,000 followers.”

“How creators can make money without waiting for brands to hire them.”

You don't need expensive equipment.

You don't need a huge following.

You don't need to be a professional influencer.

You need to be comfortable talking to a camera and communicating naturally.

Your personality matters more than perfect production.



OUR TARGET AUDIENCE

Our service is designed for people who want to build a social-commerce-based skincare business with low entry barriers and strong support.

We primarily work with:

? UGC creators and content creators who want to monetize their audience and move beyond brand collaborations

? Aspiring entrepreneurs who want to start an online business without holding inventory or dealing with manufacturing

? Social-media-native individuals who are comfortable on camera and understand how online attention works

? People interested in beauty, skincare and wellness industries

? Young mothers or individuals seeking flexible, location-independent income

? Micro-influencers and emerging creators looking to build their own brand instead of promoting others

? Individuals who want to launch a product-based business with a ready-made system and support structure

In short, we help people who already understand or are actively involved in social media, and who want to turn that into a real business opportunity.



THE COMMISSION

This position has a 30-day paid trial period.

The other four task areas will be trained live by the Project Coordinator, and you'll help turn that training into usable SOPs as you go, the same way it's worked for the rest of the team.

title: SaaS Sales Representative
description:
Skytree Scientific® builds lightning risk intelligence software. Our platform, LRAplus®, runs quantitative lightning risk assessment to IEC 62305-2:2024 Edition 3 for engineers and asset owners worldwide. Our customers are engineering consultancies across Europe, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific. 



We are hiring a SaaS Sales Representative to convert qualified pipeline into signed deals. 



This is a closing role. You will not be cold sourcing or building lists. Leads arrive qualified. Your job is to run the discovery call, give the demo, work the objections and get the contract signed. 



The motion is high-volume and fast: transactional to mid-size deals, not six-month enterprise pursuits. 



Our team works across multiple time zones, so we need someone who takes ownership of the role and moves the product forward on their own initiative. Beyond the hard skills, we want to work with people who are kind, reliable and trustworthy, and eager to grow in a startup environment. 



Responsibilities: 

Run discovery and demo calls with qualified prospects. 

Handle objections on price, timing and authority, and move deals to close. 

Navigate the buying group: prep your champion, identify the economic buyer, and build consensus across the decision team. 

Keep HubSpot current: log activity, update deal stages, maintain clean pipeline data. 

Coordinate with our account and technical teams so what you commit to on a call is what we can deliver. 

Keep objection-handling notes and feed recurring questions back to the team. 



Requirements:

SaaS or software sales experience. This one is not negotiable. Selling software is a different motion from selling hardware and we need someone who already knows it. 

Demonstrated B2B closing experience against a documented sales process. Be ready to share your quota attainment and win rate, walk us through specific deals, and explain your sales methodology. 

College degree preferred, and/or an equivalent closing track record. 

Based in the Philippines, with a reliable primary internet connection and a working backup. 

Your own work laptop or computer. 

Willingness to work flexible hours against customer time zones in Europe, MENA or Asia-Pacific (APAC). 

Strong spoken and written English for international customer-facing calls. 

CRM fluency, HubSpot preferred, with disciplined pipeline hygiene. 

A warm, credible, coachable presence. Attitude and fit count as much as skill here. 



Preferences:

Enterprise software experience. 

Familiarity with lightning risk or weather risk. 

Ability to hold a credible conversation with a technical buyer without an engineering background. 

Experience selling into a technical space, such as utilities or infrastructure. 

Experience selling software that quantifies or measures risk in another industry. 



Engagement and pay:

Pay is competitive, structured as a base plus commission. Specific figures are discussed at interview. 

This is a full-time contractor role from the start, with a 90-day probationary period. 

On passing the 90-day review, the base steps up and the commission strengthens, with an accelerator above quota. Qualified leads keep arriving from our account team; alongside closing them you take on CRM hygiene and pipeline management. Base and scope are reviewed annually from that point. 

The 90-day review looks at deals closed against target, conversion on qualified opportunities, CRM discipline, product fluency and how well you work with the rest of the team. 



How to apply

Read this part carefully. Applications that skip any step are not reviewed. 

Open your application with the word BOLT on the first line. 

1. Answer these three questions, in order: 

a. What software or SaaS product have you sold, and to what kind of buyer? 

b. Describe one software deal you closed: approximate deal size, and how you handled the main objection. 

c. What is your current close rate on qualified opportunities, and how do you know? 

2. Attach a two-minute recorded video introduction (Loom or similar). Tell us who you are, what you sell and why this role suits you. 

3. Confirm yes or no to each of the following to progress your application: 

a. SaaS or software sales experience? 

b. Based in the Philippines? 

c. Own work laptop or computer? 

d. Reliable primary internet plus a backup connection? 

e. Willing to work flexible hours to the customer's time zone? 



Shortlisted candidates move to a first-round interview, with final interviews held with the leadership team.

title: TikTok Shop Division Lead — Head of Marketplace Management (AI-Forward Agency)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We are not hiring a virtual assistant. We are hiring the person who will run an entire division.



ABOUT US




 is one of the world's first agentic marketplace management agencies. We run TikTok Shop, Amazon, and emerging marketplace channels for premium brands - and we do it with AI agents embedded in every layer of our workflow. Our clients come to us because we move faster and see more than traditional agencies do.



That only works when the people running our accounts are genuinely exceptional. We are onboarding a new tier of top-shelf clients, and we need a leader for our Marketplace Management division.



THE ROLE



You will own our marketplace management division end to end: the clients, the standards, the systems, and eventually the team. This is a senior seat with real authority, reporting directly to leadership.



If you are currently the best operator at your agency and you are tired of waiting for someone above you to move - this is that seat.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Full ownership of TikTok Shop accounts for our premium clients, from strategy through execution

- Shop setup, catalog and listing architecture, compliance, and shop health metrics

- Paid strategy across TikTok Shop Ads, GMV Max, LIVE, and shoppable video

- Affiliate and creator programs: recruitment, negotiation, commission structure, sample seeding, and performance management

- Client relationships - reporting, forecasting, QBRs, and being the calm, credible voice in the room when something goes sideways

- Building the SOPs and playbooks that let this division scale without quality slipping

- Hiring, training, and managing specialists as we grow



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Required:

- 3+ years managing TikTok Shop accounts hands-on. Not adjacent to them. Not "familiar with" them.

- A track record of scaling GMV that you can describe in real numbers

- Agency or multi-client experience - you can hold five stakeholders at once without dropping anything

- Relentless follow-through. Nothing goes silent on your watch, ever.

- Excellent written and spoken English. This role is client-facing at a senior level.

- AI-forward by default. You already use ChatGPT, Claude, or similar every single day and you can show us exactly how.



Strong bonus:

- Deep creator outreach experience and an existing network

- Affiliate program management at scale

- Amazon Seller Central or Vendor Central experience

- Experience building or leading a team

- Familiarity with agentic tooling - n8n, Make, Zapier, custom GPTs, Claude Projects, MCP



WHAT WE OFFER



- $2,000 - $3,000/month depending on experience

- Full-time, long-term, with a clear path to Head of Division

- Direct access to leadership. No bureaucracy, no politics, no waiting.

- A front-row seat building an agency in a category that did not exist two years ago

- Paid time off and performance bonuses tied to division results

- We invest in your tooling and your training. You will get sharper here.



HOW TO APPLY - PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



Start your application with the word ORBIT so we know you actually read this.



Then answer these four questions briefly and directly:



1. Which TikTok Shop accounts have you managed? Include the category, rough monthly GMV, and how long you ran them.

2. Describe one specific thing you did that moved a client's numbers. What was the before, what did you do, what was the after?

3. What AI tools are in your daily workflow, and what specifically do you use them for?

4. What is your current availability, and how soon could you be full-time with us?



Please do not send a generic resume blast. We read every application that follows these instructions, and we ignore every one that does not.

Ability to work independently with minimal daily supervision.

title: SEO Specialist with Web Development Experience Required
description:
We're Recruiting a SEO Specialist with Web Development Experience (Technical & On-Page SEO — Healthcare Websites)



APPLY HERE: 



About Allied Health Media



Allied Health Media (Allied Health Media Limited) is a UK healthcare marketing agency, headquartered in London, founded by Abhay Patel in 2022. It helps private medical consultants grow their practices through AI-driven visibility and patient acquisition — ranking them top-3 on Google Maps and AI search to drive self-pay patient calls. Its core offerings include the 12-month Practice Authority Accelerator program, a website design/build service with ongoing retainer, and the Medical Authority Media Series for video and personal branding, all delivered through an in-house team spanning growth, CS, SEO, production, design, and development.



About the Role



As our SEO Specialist, you'll own the organic search performance of a portfolio of client websites, most of them in healthcare. That means running full technical and on-page audits, catching crawling, indexing, and architecture issues before they hurt rankings, and keeping Core Web Vitals, structured data, and site health in good shape. You'll turn findings into clear, actionable tasks for developers and content teams, then verify the fixes actually landed correctly on the live site — not just take someone's word for it. You'll also track performance through GA4 and Search Console, investigate unusual traffic or ranking shifts, and report on what's working, what isn't, and what should happen next. Because our clients operate in healthcare, you'll need to apply extra care and sound judgement around medical content accuracy, not just chase quick wins.



Do Not Apply If...



You rely solely on automated tool scores instead of professional judgement

You don't follow through to confirm that requested fixes were actually implemented correctly

You're uncomfortable explaining technical SEO issues to non-technical team members

You cut corners on accuracy, especially with medical/healthcare content

You need close supervision to manage multiple client websites and priorities

You're not comfortable learning new SEO tools and platforms.

You don’t have a background or practical experience in web development. 



Key Responsibilities



Conduct comprehensive technical SEO audits, covering crawling, indexing, rendering, and site architecture.

Review and optimise XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical tags, redirects, and URL structures.

Monitor Core Web Vitals, page speed, and mobile usability.

Review and troubleshoot structured data and schema markup.

Monitor Google Search Console for indexing, crawling, and performance issues, and investigate unusual changes.

Support website migrations, redesigns, and staging-to-live launches.

Optimise on-page elements — titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, and internal linking.

Identify duplicate, thin, or competing pages and recommend consolidation or redirection.

Review and QA completed SEO and development work across desktop, tablet, and mobile before sign-off.

Retest and verify that requested fixes have been implemented correctly on the live site.

Monitor organic traffic, rankings, and conversions via GA4, and prepare clear performance reports.

Coordinate with developers, designers, and content teams — writing clear, actionable SEO tasks.

Apply extra care, accuracy, and professional judgement when working with healthcare and medical content.



Skills and Tools Required



At least two years of practical SEO experience.

Strong knowledge of technical SEO and on-page optimisation.

Experience conducting detailed website audits and prioritising fixes by impact.

Understanding of crawling, indexing, canonicalisation, redirects, and URL structures.

Experience with structured data/schema markup and Core Web Vitals.

Familiarity with WordPress or a similar CMS, plus basic HTML/CSS.

Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

Experience working with developers and verifying completed fixes.

Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical issues simply.

Working knowledge of Google Search Console, GA4, and Google Tag Manager.

Experience with SEO platforms such as Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, or Semrush.

Familiarity with PageSpeed Insights/Lighthouse, Looker Studio, and schema validation tools.



Compensation



We offer a competitive, performance-based package tailored to your experience and track record, with room to grow as you take on more client responsibility. This is a long-term opportunity with a stable, growing agency — not a short-term contract — and we reward accuracy, reliability, and great work with real career progression.



Why Join Us?



Work across a real portfolio of client websites, including meaningful healthcare projects where your work genuinely matters.

Join a fast-growing team where your audits and recommendations directly shape client results.

Flexible, remote-friendly setup with a supportive, collaborative team culture.

Room to grow into more senior SEO or strategy roles as the company scales.

Exposure to a variety of tools, platforms, and industries — never the same day twice.

A team that values professional judgement, accuracy, and follow-through over vanity metrics.

title: Assistant
description:
I'm an attorney in San Diego County, California, and I run a few small businesses alongside my law practice: a civil litigation firm (The Law Office of Aric N. Williams, Carlsbad, CA), a Waxing the City franchise studio, and Willyums Nursery, a certified-organic specialty mushroom farm.



I need one reliable, well-spoken assistant to help me run the administrative side of all of it. This is a real, long-term, part-time role with a real person — not an agency, not a one-off project. If it goes well, hours and pay grow.



HOURS



20 hours/week, Monday–Friday, roughly 4 hours per day. I need overlap with US Pacific business hours for phone calls — approximately 11:00 PM to 3:00 AM Manila time. The exact window is negotiable, and not every hour has to be during that overlap, but you must be available for live calls during part of my business day 



WHAT YOU'LL DO






Monitor and triage my inboxes; flag what's urgent

Draft replies for my approval, then send

Follow up on anything I'm waiting on



Phone calls (US-based)



Call and receive calls from clients, customers, vendors, and other offices

Appointment reminders and confirmations, status check-ins, chasing missing documents

Take clear notes and log every call



Drafting with AI



Prepare first drafts of letters, forms, and correspondence using Claude (I will train you on my process)

Fill out business, vendor, licensing, and renewal applications

Proofread and clean up AI output — you are the quality check, not the AI



Metrics and reporting



Maintain simple Google Sheets trackers: leads, appointments, revenue, social engagement

Send me one short written summary every week



Social media



Plan, create, and schedule Instagram posts, reels, and stories for the studio and the nursery

Write captions, build simple graphics in Canva, engage with comments and DMs



General admin



Calendar and scheduling

Google Drive file organization, data entry, light online research



REQUIRED (hard skills)



Excellent spoken English. Clear, confident, and easy for American callers to understand. This is the single most important requirement — you will be on the phone with my clients and customers.

Strong written English. You can draft a professional business letter with correct grammar and no typos.

Real hands-on experience with Claude and/or ChatGPT. You know how to prompt well and — more importantly — how to catch and fix what the AI gets wrong.

Instagram content creation: Canva, captions, hashtags, and scheduling tools.

Google Workspace: Gmail, Calendar, Drive, and Sheets (basic formulas, simple charts).

Reliable setup: own computer, quality headset/mic, stable internet (10 Mbps+) with a backup connection, and a quiet place to take calls.



NICE TO HAVE (not required)



Experience supporting a US law firm or professional services business

Familiarity with legal terminology, client intake, or court/administrative forms

Basic bookkeeping (QuickBooks) or CRM experience

Short-form video editing for reels



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR (soft skills)



Detail-obsessed. In legal work, a wrong date or a misspelled name is a real problem.

Discreet. You will see confidential client information. You will sign a confidentiality agreement and follow strict data-handling rules.

Self-starter. Ask questions once, then take it and run.

Honest. If you make a mistake or don't understand something, tell me immediately. I will never be upset about a flagged mistake. I will be upset about a hidden one.

Consistently available during your agreed hours.



WHAT I OFFER



Steady, long-term part-time work with room to grow into more hours and higher pay

Paid training on my systems, my AI workflow, and my templates

Direct communication with me — no middle managers, no agency

Variety: you will not be doing the same task for eight hours



HOW TO APPLY — please follow every step



Applications that skip a step will not be reviewed.



Begin your message with the word PACIFIC so I know you read the full post.

Attach or link a 60–90 second voice or video recording of yourself speaking English — introduce yourself and tell me about a job you enjoyed and why. (Loom, YouTube unlisted, or a Google Drive link is fine.) No voice sample = no interview.

Attach two short writing samples — ideally a business letter or a client
 you actually wrote.

Link 2–3 Instagram accounts you have managed or content you have created.

Answer in 3–4 sentences: Describe one time you used Claude or ChatGPT for real work. What was the task, what did you ask it, and what did you have to fix in what it gave you?

Tell me your available hours in Philippine time, and paste your speedtest.net result.



I read every application that follows these instructions. Thank you for your time.

title: AI/Integrations Specialist (N8n, Cloud Fare, Developer)

Herrman & Herrman is a high-volume personal injury law firm dedicated to using technology to improve client service, streamline operations, and empower our attorneys and staff. We are investing heavily in AI and automation and are looking for an experienced software engineer to help build the next generation of our firm's technology platform.



This is not a maintenance role—we are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, integrating systems, and building innovative solutions that will have a direct impact on how our firm operates.



---



# Position Overview



We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain an internal AI and automation platform that integrates our core business systems, modernizes reporting, and leverages AI to improve productivity across the firm.



This role will involve building custom integrations, automation workflows, reporting dashboards, and AI-powered tools that become part of our firm's daily operations.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who enjoys architecting solutions, working with APIs, and building products that solve real business problems.



---



# Primary Responsibilities

* Integrate ChatGPT Enterprise with our internal systems.

* Develop AI-powered tools that allow attorneys and staff to securely query case information using natural language.

* Build AI workflows for case summaries, document analysis, drafting assistance, and operational automation.

* Identify additional opportunities to implement AI throughout the firm.



---



### Systems Integration



Develop and maintain integrations between our core platforms, including:



* Filevine

* Lead Docket

* Zoom Phone

* Microsoft 365

* Other cloud-based legal and business applications



Projects include:



* Zoom Phone ? Filevine recording integration

* Enhancing the existing Lead Docket ? Filevine integration to support two-way synchronization

* Eliminating duplicate data entry through automation

* Building API-based workflows between systems



---



### Reporting & Business Intelligence



Design and develop a modern reporting platform to replace our current reporting limitations.



Build dashboards that provide real-time visibility into:



* Attorney fees

* Total fees

* Settlements

* Demands sent

* Revenue

* Case pipeline

* Productivity

* Operational performance



Develop attorney KPI dashboards that provide meaningful performance metrics and operational insights for firm leadership.



---



### Workflow Automation



Identify repetitive manual processes and automate them wherever possible.



Examples include:



* Document processing

* Case updates

* Notifications

* Task creation

* Reporting

* Workflow management

* AI-assisted operational tools



---



# Required Skills



* Strong experience with Node.js and/or TypeScript

* Experience designing REST APIs and web services

* Experience integrating third-party APIs

* OAuth authentication

* Cloud platforms (Google Cloud, AWS, or Azure)

* SQL and data integration experience

* Experience designing scalable software architecture

* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills



---



# Preferred Qualifications



Experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable:



* OpenAI / ChatGPT Enterprise integrations

* Google Cloud Run

* Google Cloud Tasks

* Webhooks

* Workflow automation

* Business intelligence dashboards

* Data visualization

* Filevine API

* Legal technology platforms

* CRM or case management software integrations



---



# What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate enjoys building systems rather than simply maintaining them.



You should be someone who:



* Thinks like an architect

* Enjoys solving complex business problems with technology

* Can work independently

* Can recommend better approaches rather than simply following specifications

* Is excited about AI and automation

* Wants to build long-term solutions that scale



---



# Why Join Us?



This is an opportunity to build technology that will fundamentally change how an established law firm operates.



Rather than working on isolated projects, you'll help create a centralized platform that combines:



* Artificial Intelligence

* Workflow Automation

* Systems Integration

* Business Intelligence

* Operational Dashboards

* Custom Internal Applications



Your work will directly impact attorneys, staff, and leadership by reducing manual work, improving decision-making, and creating a more intelligent, data-driven organization.



We're looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term technology partner as we continue expanding AI and automation throughout the firm.

Comfortable populating reports and dashboards from templates, with the commercial literacy to sense-check the numbers

title: Affiliate Partnerships Coordinator (Remote)
description:

Ella Bella is an established hair tools and hair care brand with a strong presence on Amazon. As we continue expanding across TikTok Shop, Shopify, Walmart, and other platforms, we're looking for someone to help grow and manage our creator and affiliate partnerships.



Our main focus is TikTok Shop, but we're also building creator and affiliate partnerships across other platforms.

Affiliate marketing experience is a plus, but not required. We're more focused on finding someone with excellent attention to detail, strong written communication skills, good judgment, adaptability, and the ability to work independently.

• Build and maintain long-term relationships with creators and affiliates

• Guide partners through onboarding and provide ongoing support

• Follow up regularly to keep partnerships active and engaged

• Review creator profiles, content, and performance against our partnership criteria

• Track outreach, creator activity, and partnership progress accurately

• Analyze creator performance and identify opportunities to improve recruitment, engagement, and campaign results

• Support creator campaigns, competitions, and community initiatives

• Handle day-to-day creator and affiliate tasks independently while flagging unusual situations when needed

• Help improve our creator recruitment, outreach, and affiliate partnership programs



We're Looking for Someone Who Is

• Highly detail-oriented — you carefully read instructions, notice important details, and work accurately

• A strong written communicator — you communicate clearly and naturally with creators and team members

• Independent with good judgment — you can handle your responsibilities without constant guidance and know when you should ask before proceeding

• Proactive — if something doesn't look right, you investigate or flag it instead of simply continuing

• Organized — you stay on top of multiple conversations, tasks, follow-ups, and records

• Quick to learn and adaptable — you adjust quickly when processes, priorities, or instructions change and apply new guidance accurately

• Accountable — you take ownership of your work, apply feedback, and follow through on commitments



Requirements

• Excellent written English

• Strong reading comprehension

• Excellent time management and organizational skills

• Ability to follow detailed written instructions accurately

• Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, changing environment

• Reliable computer and internet connection

• Available to work US Eastern Time business hours (night shift in the Philippines)

• Previous experience in affiliate marketing, creator partnerships, influencer marketing, TikTok Shop, or e-commerce is an advantage, but not required.



Why You'll Love Working With Us

• Competitive salary

• Fully remote

• Stable, long-term opportunity

• Friendly and supportive international team

• Career growth opportunities

• Hands-on experience in affiliate marketing, creator partnerships, and e-commerce

• Opportunity to help shape and improve a rapidly growing creator program

• Take ownership of work that directly impacts our creator partnerships



What Success Looks Like

• Within your first few months, you should be able to:

• Manage creator and affiliate tasks with increasing independence

• Build strong relationships with creators and recruit high-quality partners

• Keep outreach and partnership records accurate and organized

• Adapt quickly to changing priorities and processes

• Apply feedback consistently and avoid repeating the same issues

• Help the team improve and scale our creator and affiliate partnerships



How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with brief answers to the following questions:

Please answer the questions in your own words. We're interested in how you naturally communicate and think.

title: Short Form Video Editor for Ecommerce Ads (Meta, UGC, AI Video)
description:
About us



We are a small ecommerce brand in the health and supplement space. We sell to customers in the United States and Canada, and we run our advertising on
 and Instagram. The business is run by one person right now, so you will be working directly with the owner, not through a manager or an agency layer.



We are looking for an editor to build these ads for us on a project basis. Work comes in batches. Some months there are several, some months there are none. We are not offering fixed weekly hours, so please only apply if project work suits you.



When a batch goes well, we come back to the same editor for the next one. Most of our work ends up going to a small number of people we trust.



What the job is



You will build the short video ads we run on
 and Instagram. Each batch is 3 to 5 videos, 30 to 90 seconds long, vertical format.



For every batch you will receive a written brief. The brief gives you the script, the hook, the pacing, and notes on what visuals we want. Your job is to turn that brief into a finished ad.



Your work will include:



Editing raw creator footage into a finished ad with captions, pacing, and sound design

Finding your own clips when a brief does not come with footage. We will tell you exactly what to look for. You find it and choose well.

Building AI video ads. This includes AI UGC avatars, faceless voiceover videos, cartoon and animated styles, and AI generated B-roll.

Adding on screen text and captions that are timed correctly

Exporting in 9:16, plus 1:1 and 4:5 versions

Making new versions of ads that perform well, usually a new opening with the same body



Requirements



At least 1 year editing short form video.
, Instagram, or TikTok content.

Strong with CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or After Effects

Real experience with AI video and voice tools. For example ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Higgsfield, Veo, Runway, or similar. Tell us which ones you use and show us work you made with them.

Able to deliver a batch of 3 ads within 48 hours

Computer that can run your editing software smoothly, plus stable internet for uploading large video files

Good written English. You will be reading briefs and asking questions in writing.

Comfortable working from a written brief without needing a call for every task



What makes you a strong fit



You have edited ads for an ecommerce brand before and can name the brand

You understand that the first 3 seconds decide whether the ad works

You ask a question when something in the brief is unclear instead of guessing

You want to learn the marketing side, not just the editing side. Over time we want you to understand why the ads are built the way they are, so you can make more of the decisions yourself.



What working with us looks like



You work directly with the owner. No middle layer, no chasing approvals.

Briefs are written out properly, so you are not guessing what we want

Any tools or accounts you need for the work are provided

Feedback is specific and comes back quickly

Editors who deliver get first call on every batch after that, and more freedom over how the ads get built



How to apply



Please send an application that includes all of the following:



Start your message with the word "pretzel" so we know you read the whole posting.

Links to 2 or 3 short form ads you personally edited. Tell us what your role was on each one.

At least one example of something you made using AI video tools, and which tools you used.

The editing software you use and your computer specifications.

Your internet speed and your available working hours in Philippine time.



Applications without the word "pretzel" will not be read. Please do not send an application written by ChatGPT. We would rather hear from you in your own words.



Shortlisted applicants will get one small batch to start. Everyone gets the same brief so we can compare fairly.

title: Senior WordPress Developer & Graphic Designer – Full-Time
description:
We’re a 34-year-old Australian technology and events company looking for a highly capable Senior WordPress Developer & Graphic Designer to join our team full-time.



This is a hands-on technical and creative role. We are looking for someone who is genuinely strong in BOTH WordPress development and graphic design.



You’ll work directly with our Australian Sales Manager and become a key part of developing and improving our websites, landing pages, product pages, graphics, photography and overall digital presence.



WEB DEVELOPMENT



A major part of your role will be taking ownership of the ongoing development and improvement of our WordPress websites.



Your work will include:

- WordPress website development and maintenance

- Advanced Elementor / Elementor Pro development

- WooCommerce products, categories and shop development

- Building new landing pages and website sections

- WordPress theme and template customisation

- HTML and CSS development

- JavaScript modifications where required

- Responsive development across desktop, tablet and mobile

- Troubleshooting WordPress, plugin and layout problems

- Website speed and performance improvements

- UX and conversion improvements

- Managing redirects, URLs and website structure

- Implementing tracking scripts and website integrations

- Testing and deploying website changes



We particularly want someone who can be given an outcome such as “we need this page to work like this” and independently determine how to build it.



GRAPHIC DESIGN



You’ll also be an important internal resource for our graphic design and image production.



Your work will include:

- Adobe Photoshop – strong competency is essential

- Canva

- Website banners and hero graphics

- Product imagery

- Photo retouching and colour correction

- Background removal and image manipulation

- Corporate event photography enhancement

- Social media and advertising graphics

- Website icons and supporting graphics

- Sales and marketing collateral

- Maintaining consistency with our existing brand



We want someone with a good design eye, not simply someone who knows how to use Photoshop and Canva.



SEO & DIGITAL MARKETING



Our SEO strategy is managed by a specialist third-party agency, so you will NOT be responsible for developing our SEO strategy.



However, the Web Developer is a vital part of actually making that strategy happen.



You’ll work with our Australian Sales Manager and SEO specialists to implement recommendations including new landing pages, website structure changes, internal linking, redirects, technical fixes, content layouts, metadata, schema and other website improvements.



Basic SEO knowledge is highly desirable, but your primary responsibility is being able to correctly build and implement the required website changes.



SKILLS WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You should already be highly competent with:

- WordPress

- Elementor Pro

- WooCommerce

- HTML

- CSS

- Adobe Photoshop

- Canva

- Additional experience with JavaScript, PHP, Cloudflare, GA4, Google Tag Manager, technical SEO, website performance optimisation and Adobe Creative Cloud will be highly regarded.



We value people who can troubleshoot problems independently, research solutions and get things done without requiring constant step-by-step instructions.



SALARY & BENEFITS



AUD $1,000–$1,500 per month depending on demonstrated skills and experience.



The package also includes SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG.



This is a genuine full-time, long-term position with an established Australian company.



WORKING HOURS

- Monday–Friday

- 7:00 AM–3:30 PM Philippine Time

- This includes a 30-minute unpaid lunch break, providing 40 paid working hours per week.



These hours align with our Australian office, allowing you to work directly with our Sales Manager and Australian team throughout the working day.



ABOUT US



We are an established Australian company operating in the technology, IT rental and corporate events industry for 34 years.



Our business works with everything from laptops, computers and servers through to LED displays, touchscreens, audiovisual equipment and major corporate event technology.



We’re an established business that is actively investing in our websites, digital presence, technology and systems.



This isn't a role where you'll spend all day making minor content updates. We want someone who enjoys building things, solving problems and seeing their work have a direct impact on a real business.



IMPORTANT – PRACTICAL SKILLS TEST



Please only apply if you genuinely have the skills required for this position.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a practical skills examination / live demonstration BEFORE progressing to a formal interview.



You may be asked to demonstrate WordPress and Elementor development, troubleshoot a website problem, reproduce a supplied design, complete a Photoshop task or explain how you would approach a practical development problem.



Your CV and portfolio may get you through the door. Your demonstrated ability will determine whether you progress to interview.



We’re looking for someone who wants to become a long-term and important member of our team, take ownership of our websites and creative output, and see the direct impact of their work on a growing Australian business.

title: Job Posting - Ecommerce Bookkeeper & Daily Profit Reporting Analyst
description:
Job description



I'm looking for an Ecommerce Bookkeeper & Daily Profit Reporting Analyst to join our team. You will own the numbers. Your core deliverable is a daily profit report, in our slack inbox every morning, that tells us exactly what we made yesterday - revenue, fees, COGS, ad spend across every channel, tax, fixed costs, refunds, and net profit on the day. You will also keep our books clean, own the month-end close, and be the person who can answer "where did the money actually go?" without us having to guess.



We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of experience doing ecommerce bookkeeping or finance for a DTC brand. The ideal candidate has worked directly inside Shopify, has reconciled Shopify Payments payouts properly, understands UK VAT, and has built a daily or weekly P&L that a founder actually used to make decisions. Bonus points for multi-currency and multi-market experience.



This is not a data entry role. We are scaling fast across two countries and our margins are tight. The person in this seat is the reason we know whether a decision made us money or cost us money.



Who are we?



We're a dog brand that solves a problem millions of dog owners live with every single day. Since launch we have scaled to over £1.7M in revenue in our first 120 days, built thousands of five-star reviews, and are now expanding into the United States.



We are a small, remote, fast-moving team. Everything we do is measured. We operate with real numbers, tight margins and high urgency, and we are building a business that can survive scrutiny - not one that looks good on a dashboard.



What is our culture like & who is a good fit?



Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring. We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less, and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values: work smart, overdeliver, speed is king, and better every day. We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5, this isn't it.



For this role specifically, we need someone who is genuinely bothered by a number that doesn't reconcile. Someone who will chase a £400 discrepancy because they want to know what caused it, not because they were asked. Someone who tells the founder bad news early rather than burying it in a spreadsheet tab.



If you want to challenge yourself, work directly with the founder, and be trusted with the single most important information in the business - you have come to the right place.



Key Objectives



- Deliver a daily net profit report every morning, covering the previous day, with every cost line accounted for.

- Own the weekly KPI sheet - populate it with verified figures before our Monday review so decisions are made on real data, not estimates.

- Maintain accurate books in our accounting software, reconciled to the bank and to Shopify payouts.

- Track and report refunds, returns and chargebacks as a percentage of revenue, and flag any trend early.

- Ask question about where funds are moving to and why to keep track

- Maintain a live cash position and VAT liability figure so we always know what is ours and what belongs to HMRC.

- Own month-end close and prepare everything our accountant needs for VAT returns and year-end.

- Build and maintain the COGS and landed cost model per SKU, updating as supplier and freight costs change.

- Flag anomalies proactively - unexpected charges, subscription creep, duplicate payments, fee changes.

- Support our expansion into the US: Separate market-level P&L.

Requirements

- Fully remote. Based in the Philippines or a compatible timezone.

- Fluent written English. You will be writing commentary, not just filling cells.

- 3+ years of ecommerce bookkeeping or finance experience, ideally with a DTC brand doing meaningful volume.

- Hands-on experience with Shopify admin, Shopify Payments payouts and reports — not just an export someone else gave you.

- Proficiency with Xero or QuickBooks Online, and ideally a Shopify reconciliation tool such as A2X or Link My Books.

- Advanced Google Sheets / Excel. You can build a reporting model from scratch, not just maintain someone else's.

- Working knowledge of UK VAT - what is and isn't included in revenue, standard vs zero rated, and how the liability accrues.

- Comfortable with multi-currency reporting and FX differences.

- Familiarity with reading ad platform spend from Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.

- Accurate to the point of being slightly obsessive. Small errors compound into wrong decisions here.

- Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.

- Accountabilities

- Deliver the daily profit report by 5:00am UK time, every working day, without being chased (12:00pm Philippines time)

- Populate the weekly KPI sheet with verified figures before Monday morning.

- Reconcile all Shopify Payments payouts to orders, with any variance explained.

- Complete month-end close within 5 working days of month end.

- Maintain a rolling refund and return rate, reported weekly.

- Maintain an up-to-date VAT liability figure at all times.

- Keep the COGS model current within one week of any supplier or freight cost change.

- Raise any cost anomaly within 24 hours of spotting it.

- Prepare quarterly figures and commentary for the founder and the external accountant.



How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate



1. Initial Loom: Max 4 minutes



Topics



- Introduce yourself!



- The last ecommerce business whose books you owned

e.g. Name the brand or describe it - what they sold, roughly what revenue, which platform. Then: what did you specifically own versus what did someone else do. Which tools. And how long.



- Screen-share a profit report you've built

e.g. Redact whatever they need to. Walk through the line items and say where each number came from. Then: what's the one thing about it that was hardest to get right





2. Interview



After the loom, we will reach out and get you scheduled for an interview with the founder to chat more about the role, answer any questions and exchange ideas.



Salary Expectation: USD $450/month - Covers daily P&L delivery, weekly KPI sheet and call, and monthly close and reporting. Ongoing workload is approximately 30–35 hours per month. 



This is a part-time, long-term engagement — you're free to hold other clients, provided the 9:00am UK delivery and month-end deadlines are met. We will review scope and compensation as the business grows.

Before applying, ask yourself: Are you comfortable opening a browser console? Can you read a JSON response and understand what it is telling you? Do you know what to look for in the network tab when an API call fails? If yes, this role is for you. If those questions are unfamiliar, this is not the right fit.



What You Will Do

- Investigate and resolve technical issues reported by customers using browser dev tools, system logs, and API inspection.

- Read and interpret JSON payloads and API responses, and communicate findings clearly to both customers and developers.

- Reproduce bugs and escalate to the development team with thorough, documented evidence.

- Lead customer onboarding sessions with structured walkthroughs and hands-on setup guidance.

- Build internal documentation and knowledge base articles from real support cases.

- Use Microsoft Planner to manage daily tasks and track work in progress, keeping boards updated and priorities current without being prompted.

- Use ClickUp to manage QA workflows: tracking bugs, documenting test results, and following feature releases from testing through resolution , on your own initiative, not on a checklist someone handed you.

- Maintain accurate customer records and support interaction history in Microsoft Dynamics CRM, keeping documentation current.



Requirements

- 3+ years in technical support for a web-based or cloud software platform.

- Hands-on experience with browser developer tools — console, network tab, log inspection.

- Working knowledge of APIs: reading JSON payloads, interpreting HTTP status codes, tracing failed calls.

- Experience onboarding and training customers on software platforms.

- Strong written and spoken English — you will be communicating directly with US-based clients.

- Familiarity with QA processes and the ability to write clear bug reports for development teams.

- Self-directed, reliable, and able to manage your own workload without micromanagement.

- Available to work full US business hours (Eastern time).



How to Apply

Use subject line: Tech Support – [Your Name]



Include your resume link, LinkedIn profile (if available), brieft description of your experiences and written answers to both questions below. Applications without answers to both questions will not be reviewed.



1. Give an example of a bug or product issue you caught during QA or support work. What was the issue, how did you document it, and how did you communicate it to the development team?



2. A customer reports that messages sent through our platform are not being delivered. You have access to logs and browser dev tools. Walk us through how you would investigate — what do you check first, what are you looking for, and how do you determine whether the issue is on the platform side or the customer's side?

Archer Wealth is a Sydney-based private credit lender. Our entire technology platform — broker portal, credit workbench, warehouse reporting, loan management — has been built by the founder. What you'll do

*Required*

- Experience owning production systems solo or in a very small team

 with your CV and a short note on a production system you've owned. Shortlisted candidates complete an online assessment, then a paid 1–2 week trial project.

REPORTING

s in the Klaviyo editor to a high visual standard

title: Sales / Client Conversations - Software Studio (US clients, base + commission)
description:
Hi, I run a small software development studio in California called Elden. We build custom web apps, automations and integrations for US businesses - things like inventory sync tools, internal dashboards, AI features, that kind of work.



We have a system that finds US business owners who are actively looking to hire a developer, and it starts the conversation for them by text. It works. People reply, and we send them a short video of something similar we already built.



What we do not have is a person. Right now those conversations reach a real, interested human being and then nobody picks them up properly. That is the job.



WHAT YOU WOULD ACTUALLY DO ALL DAY



- Reply to US business owners who have already responded to us. Mostly by text message, sometimes a short call on Zoom.

- Understand what they are trying to build, in plain language, and explain how we would approach it. You will not be writing code. You will have a real AI assistant on screen that pulls the answer for you, plus written notes on every offer and price we have.

- Get them to a small first project (usually $400, paid only after it works) and then to a bigger build.

- Work through our backlog of leads that need a human touch.

- Keep good notes so we know what happened.



WHAT YOU NEED



- Excellent written English, and specifically a casual American style. We do not text people like a formal business letter. We text like a normal person - lowercase, short sentences, no "I hope this message finds you well". If you can do that naturally, you are most of the way there.

- Comfortable on a video call with an American, and comfortable being on camera.

- Willing to work US hours. This is a night shift from the Philippines. Be honest with yourself about that before applying.

- Reliable. If you say you are online at 9, you are online at 9.

- Curious about software. You do not need to be a developer. You need to be the kind of person who reads how something works and can then explain it back.



WHAT YOU DO NOT NEED



- Sales experience. We will train you and give you scripts, recordings, and an AI assistant that suggests what to say in real time.

- A technical degree.

- Your own leads. We generate them.



A REAL PLUS



If you have ever played with Claude Code, Cursor, or any similar AI coding tool, even just for fun on a side project, mention it. It is not required and you will not be writing code. It just tells me you are someone who goes and figures things out on their own, which is most of what this job is.



PAY



- Paid trial week first: $150 for 5 days, about 4 hours a day. This is paid whether or not we go forward.

- Then $700/month base, paid twice a month by Wise.

- Plus commission: $75 every time a client pays their first $400 project, 12% of every project we get paid for, and 10% of the first month plus 5% of months 2 to 6 on any monthly client you bring in.

- Plus $15 for every conversation you personally carry through to a delivered video, and $25 for every dead lead you revive.

- Realistically that is $1,200-$2,400 a month once you are up to speed, and more if you are good. We will raise the base at month 4 if it is working.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word BLUEPRINT so I know you read this.



Then send me:



1. Two or three sentences on the most technical thing you have ever had to explain to someone who did not understand it.

2. This: a US business owner texts you "how much?" about a tool that syncs his Shopify inventory with a spreadsheet. Write your actual reply, exactly as you would send it. One text message.

3. A 2-3 minute video of you talking, no script, telling me about yourself. Phone camera is fine.



I read every application that starts with BLUEPRINT. I will reply to you either way.

title: B2B Cold Email Campaign Manager
description:
About AI Scaling



AI Scaling builds software and provides operational support for AI agencies that sell and deliver AI implementation services to small and medium-sized businesses. Through our licensee partner network, we give agency owners the technology, training, marketing, sales, and implementation support needed to operate and grow their businesses.



We are hiring a B2B Cold
 Campaign Manager to build and manage outbound campaigns that generate qualified sales opportunities for our licensee agencies.



The role



You will own the day-to-day execution and improvement of multiple B2B cold
 campaigns. This includes translating each licensee's offer and ideal customer profile into a campaign plan, building targeted prospect lists, writing sequences, configuring sending systems, protecting deliverability, launching campaigns, and improving performance.



This is a hands-on role for someone who has personally managed cold outbound campaigns. It is not a newsletter, lifecycle
, or general copywriting position.



What you will own



• Build and segment prospect lists using tools such as Apollo, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or comparable platforms.

• Write and test concise cold
 sequences, subject lines, calls to action, and follow-ups.

• Configure and operate sending platforms such as Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist, or Reply.io.

• Monitor domains, mailboxes, authentication, bounce rates, spam signals, sending volume, and suppression rules.

• Diagnose weak performance across targeting, data quality, offers, copy, deliverability, and follow-up.

• Route replies and meetings into the appropriate CRM and sales workflow.

• Report results clearly and manage multiple licensee campaigns without losing accuracy or follow-through.



What success looks like



• Campaigns launch on schedule and pass quality checks.

• Prospect data is accurate, relevant, and properly segmented.

• Deliverability remains healthy and problems are addressed early.

• Positive replies, qualified meetings, and sales opportunities improve through disciplined testing.

• Each campaign has clear reporting, documented changes, and a defined next action.



What we are looking for



• At least two years of hands-on B2B cold
 campaign management.

• Experience owning campaigns from planning through launch and optimization.

• Strong working knowledge of deliverability, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC, domain health, mailbox ramping, verification, and bounce control.

• Experience with at least one cold
 sending platform and one prospecting or enrichment workflow.

• Good judgment in audience selection, segmentation, offers, copy, and testing.

• Experience connecting campaign activity to CRM records, meetings, opportunities, or sales outcomes.

• Clear communication and the ability to manage several campaigns reliably.



Experience with agencies, SaaS, consulting, AI implementation, automation, or other complex B2B services is helpful but not required.



What we offer



• $4,000-$6,000 per month, based on experience and demonstrated results.

• A remote, worldwide, full-time contract position.

• Flexible working hours with dependable overlap during agreed working hours.

• Long-term work for strong performers.

• Direct ownership of campaigns that affect partner pipeline and revenue.

• The opportunity to take on broader campaign leadership as AI Scaling grows.



How to apply



Please include:

1. A short description of one B2B cold
 campaign you personally managed, including the offer, audience, volume, results, and the most important change you made.

2. The tools you use for prospecting, enrichment, verification, sending, deliverability monitoring, and CRM handoff.

3. A sanitized campaign report, brief, or similar example that shows how you work. Do not share confidential client information.

4. Your location, availability, and preferred working hours.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid assessment using a generic AI implementation offer. The assessment tests campaign judgment and communication, not knowledge of AI Scaling's internal systems.

title: Book keeper
description:
Construction Admin & MYOB Job Costing VA



We are an Australian demolition, excavation and civil works company looking for a reliable, switched-on Virtual Assistant to help manage our MYOB administration, invoicing, job costing and general project administration.



This is intended to become an ongoing position for the right person.



Main Responsibilities



You will assist with:



* Creating and sending customer quotes in MYOB

* Creating progress claims and invoices

* Entering supplier invoices and expenses

* Allocating costs to the correct project/job

* Maintaining accurate job costing records

* Tracking labour, subcontractors, plant hire, truck hire, tipping fees and materials

* Comparing quoted costs against actual job costs

* Tracking variations and additional works

* Monitoring outstanding and overdue invoices

* Maintaining supplier and subcontractor records

* Organising receipts, invoices and project documentation

* Preparing simple weekly job profitability reports

* General construction administration



Job Costing



This is a very important part of the role.



For each project, we want to clearly see:



Original Contract / Quote Value

Approved Variations

Total Revenue

Labour Costs

Plant & Equipment Costs

Subcontractor Costs

Waste / Tipping Costs

Materials & Other Costs

Total Actual Cost

Gross Profit

Gross Margin %



You must be comfortable receiving information from us in a practical construction format and turning it into organised job-costing records.



For example:



Excavator – 3 

Float – $350

Labour – 2 men × 8 

Truck – $400/day

Dirt disposal – 25 

Dumper hire – $198/day



You should be able to correctly calculate, record and allocate these costs to the appropriate project.



Required Experience



Applicants should have:



* Strong MYOB experience

* Experience with invoicing, quotes and accounts payable/receivable

* Good Excel or Google Sheets skills

* Strong numerical ability and attention to detail

* Good written English

* Excellent organisation

* Ability to work independently

* Reliable internet connection



Experience working with an Australian construction, demolition, excavation, civil or trade business is highly desirable.



Previous construction job-costing experience will be strongly preferred.



What We’re Looking For



We want someone who takes ownership of their work.



If something doesn’t reconcile, we want you to investigate it rather than simply enter the numbers.



If a supplier invoice doesn’t identify which project it belongs to, flag it.



If actual costs on a project are approaching or exceeding the allowance, tell us.



If a customer invoice becomes overdue, flag it.



The goal is to give management an accurate picture of what every project is costing and whether it is making money.



Application Instructions



Please include the following in your application:



1. How many years of MYOB experience do you have?

2. Which MYOB products have you used?

3. Have you worked for an Australian construction or trade business before?

4. Describe how you have previously managed job costing.

5. What information would you include in a weekly job profitability report?

6. What is your expected hourly rate in PHP?

7. How many hours per week are you available?

8. What hours are you available in Sydney, Australia time?



Please start your application with the words:



“JOB COSTING”



Applications that do not include this will not be considered.



Shortlisted Applicant Test



Shortlisted applicants will be given a small paid job-costing exercise before appointment.



The exercise will involve taking a sample construction project with labour, machinery, disposal and subcontractor costs and producing a simple job-cost report showing:



* Revenue

* Total costs

* Cost categories

* Gross profit

* Gross margin

* Any errors or missing information they identify



We are looking for accuracy, initiative and attention to detail — not just data entry.
