title: Sales & Patient Acquisition Lead — $1,000+/month Potential (US Hours)
description:
PLEASE READ FIRST — do not apply through OnlineJobs.ph.

Applications sent through this site are not reviewed. To be considered, you must apply through our own form here: 
tion.site/3b70d95da57c80ec9e3ff25ac24cd60a

It takes about 10 minutes and includes a short voice recording.



Hi, I'm Dr. Abrar Al-Shaer, PhD, RD, LDN: a registered dietitian nutritionist and herbalist in the United States. I run Precision Women's Care, an integrative practice where we help women get to the root of their health issues — PCOS, fertility, hormones, gut health, perimenopause — and feel like themselves again.



We're a small, close team, fully remote, and we care a great deal about the women who come to us.



Women find us, reach out, and genuinely want help — and then some of them quietly slip away because nobody followed up well enough. I'm looking for someone to own our front door: the leads, the phone, the follow-up, and the conversation that turns an interested woman into a patient.



This is a sales role, and it's also the first voice a woman hears from our practice. Both have to be true at once.



About the pay, before anything else. Your base is $7/hour, but this role is built so your income follows your results, not the clock. You earn a bonus on every patient and member you bring in, so $1,000+ a month is well within reach if you convert well. Do this properly and you should out-earn the hourly rate comfortably.



What you'll do

- Follow up quickly with every woman who reaches out, and guide her toward booking

- Have the real conversation: what we offer, what it costs, and what's holding her back

- Turn interested women into patients and members

- Keep following up with the ones who say "let me think about it" — this is where most of the value lives

- Answer and return calls on our practice phone during US hours

- Schedule patient follow-ups and make sure nothing sits unanswered



Who I'm looking for



Near-native English comes first, and it isn't negotiable. You'll be on the phone with American women talking about deeply personal things. You need to sound warm, natural, and completely at ease — able to hear hesitation in someone's voice and respond to it. Not scripted. Not stiff.



- You've actually sold something and closed it. Health, wellness, coaching, or memberships is a real plus

- You're comfortable with money. You can say a price out loud and then stay quiet

- You're warm, not pushy. Hard-closing will damage the trust our patients place in us

- You run yourself. You'll own the follow-up. Nobody will chase you

- You can work a consistent 4-hour block each weekday, on US Eastern time

- This role is open to women only. Our patients are women discussing fertility and hormones, and they've told us plainly that they're more comfortable speaking with another woman



The details

- Pay: $7/hour base, plus a bonus on every patient and member you bring in. A strong month lands around $1,000+ per month

- Hours: 20 per week to start — the same 4-hour block each weekday, US Eastern

- Growth: 4-week paid fellowship ? 3 months part-time ? full-time based on performance

- We provide: our practice phone system, Notion, and Toggl



How to apply

1. Application and voice recording: 
tion.site/3b70d95da57c80ec9e3ff25ac24cd60a.

2. Interview. A real conversation, with some role-play.

3. Fellowship. A paid 4 weeks working alongside us. That's how we both find out if this is right.



If you're wonderful on the phone and you want your work to genuinely change how a woman feels in her own body, I'd love to hear from you.



— Abrar

title: Creator Sourcing & Influencer Outreach Specialist
description:
Creator Sourcing & Influencer Outreach Specialist



Full Time - Must map to US working hours. 



About Ingreendients



Ingreendients is a plant-based personal care brand focused on high-performing hair care and body care products made with transparent, plant-derived ingredients.



We are building a creator-led marketing program across Instagram and TikTok and are looking for a highly organized, persistent, and resourceful person to help us identify creators, manage outreach, coordinate product seeding, and build a consistent pipeline of authentic video content.



This is not a general social media posting role.



Your primary responsibility will be to help us find the right creators and turn those relationships into high-quality videos that can be tested through paid advertising.



The Role



You will spend a significant portion of each day researching creators on Instagram and TikTok who are a strong fit for our brand.



You will then organize them, evaluate their content, reach out to them, follow up, coordinate product shipments, track communication, and help move each creator from initial discovery through completed content and advertising permissions.



Our goal is to build a large and continuously growing library of authentic creator videos that can be tested across Meta, Instagram, TikTok, Amazon, and other marketing channels.



Primary Responsibilities



Creator Research and Sourcing



* Research Instagram and TikTok creators every day

* Identify creators in clean beauty, hair care, wellness, non-toxic living, fitness, motherhood, lifestyle, and related niches

* Find micro-creators, small and mid sized creators

* Review creator content for authenticity, communication style, video quality, audience alignment, and advertising potential

* Identify creators who are comfortable speaking on camera and demonstrating products

* Build and maintain a large, organized creator database

* Avoid duplicate outreach and keep creator records accurate



Creator Evaluation



For each creator, evaluate and record:



* Name

* Instagram and TikTok handles

* Platform links

* Follower count

* Estimated engagement

* Primary niche

* Audience profile

* Location

* Content style

* Video quality

* On-camera communication

* Brand fit

* Past beauty or wellness collaborations

* Contact information

* Why the creator may be a strong fit

* Potential content angle

* Outreach status



Outreach and Follow-Up



* Send personalized outreach messages by
, Instagram, and TikTok

* Avoid generic mass outreach

* Explain why each creator is relevant to the brand

* Follow up consistently and professionally

* Respond to creator questions

* Track negotiations and creator expectations

* Schedule calls when necessary

* Maintain accurate records of every interaction



Product Seeding and Content Coordination



* Collect shipping details

* Coordinate product shipments with the operations team

* Track delivery

* Follow up after product delivery

* Confirm which products and content concepts the creator will test

* Help prepare creative briefs and talking points

* Track expected delivery dates for content

* Follow up until content is received

* Organize completed videos and raw files



Whitelisting and Advertising Permissions



* Ask creators for permission to use their content in paid advertising

* Help coordinate Meta Partnership Ads, Instagram permissions, TikTok Spark Ads, and other whitelisting processes

* Maintain records of usage rights and agreed terms

* Confirm whether content can be edited, resized, and used across multiple channels

* Coordinate with the Founder and marketing team when content is ready for testing



Reporting and Organization



* Maintain a clean creator pipeline in Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, or another approved system

* Provide daily and weekly progress updates

* Report outreach volume, replies, interested creators, products shipped, content received, and permissions secured

* Identify bottlenecks and recommend process improvements

* Create and improve SOPs for creator sourcing, outreach, follow-up, and content tracking



What Success Looks Like



The successful person in this role will consistently:



* Find high-quality, relevant creators

* Send thoughtful and personalized outreach

* Follow up without needing reminders

* Keep the creator pipeline extremely organized

* Move creators from initial contact to completed content

* Build strong and respectful creator relationships

* Help us create a growing library of authentic videos

* Improve the process over time using AI, templates, and systems



Initial Performance Expectations



During the first 30–60 days, we expect you to build a repeatable creator sourcing and outreach system.



Potential activity targets may include:



* Researching and evaluating 30–50 relevant creators per day

* Sending 15–30 personalized outreach messages per day

* Completing consistent follow-ups

* Maintaining accurate pipeline records

* Securing a growing number of interested creators each week

* Helping move creators toward product trials, completed videos, and paid advertising permissions



Quality is more important than sending large volumes of generic messages.



Required Qualifications



* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong internet research skills

* Highly organized and detail-oriented

* Comfortable spending several hours each day researching creators

* Strong follow-up discipline

* Professional and friendly communication

* Comfortable using Instagram and TikTok

* Strong Google Sheets skills

* Comfortable learning new software and systems

* Ability to work independently and manage repetitive workflows accurately

* Willingness to work U.S. business hours

* Reliable internet and computer



referred Experience



Experience in one or more of the following is helpful:



* Influencer marketing

* Creator sourcing

* Influencer outreach

* Affiliate marketing

* Social media research

* UGC coordination

* Beauty, wellness, hair care, or consumer products

* Meta Partnership Ads

* Instagram whitelisting

* TikTok Spark Ads

* Creator databases or CRM systems



Prior experience is helpful, but intelligence, persistence, organization, communication, and willingness to learn are equally important.



## AI and Workflow Expectations



You should be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to:



* Research creators

* Improve outreach messages

* Personalize communication

* Summarize creator profiles

* Generate content-angle ideas

* Organize information

* Improve follow-up systems

* Create SOPs and workflow efficiencies



AI should improve the quality and speed of your work, not produce generic or impersonal outreach.



## Who You Are



You may be a strong fit if:



* You enjoy research and finding people online

* You are naturally persistent

* You do not give up after one unanswered message

* You are highly organized

* You enjoy communicating with creators

* You notice quality and authenticity in videos

* You can follow a detailed process consistently

* You take ownership without waiting for constant instructions

* You are interested in building something long-term



## To Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your resume

2. A short introduction explaining why this role interests you

3. Any relevant influencer, outreach, research, social media, or creator-management experience





Please also complete the short application exercise below.



Application Exercise



Part 1 — Creator Research



Find 10 Instagram or TikTok creators who you believe would be a strong fit for Ingreendients.



Please include:



* Creator name

* Instagram or TikTok handle

* Platform link

* Follower count

* Content niche

* Why you selected them

* One content angle you believe they could create for the brand

* Whether you believe they would be a strong candidate for paid advertising and why



Please DO NOT select celebrities or very large creators. Focus will be on micro, small and mid-size creators.



Part 2 — Outreach



Write one personalized outreach message to one of the creators you selected.



The message should:



* Reference something specific about the creator

* Explain why the creator fits the brand

* Invite them to try the products

* Sound warm and human

* Avoid sounding like a mass template



Part 3 — Organization



Create a simple spreadsheet showing how you would track:



* Creator researched

* Outreach sent

* Follow-up dates

* Response

* Shipping status

* Content due date

* Content received

* Advertising permission

* Final status



Please submit the spreadsheet as a Google Sheets link or Excel file.



Part 4 — Short Written Response



Please answer:



* How would you decide whether a creator's video is suitable for paid advertising?

* What would you do if a creator did not respond after the first message?

* How would you manage 200–300 creators without losing track of conversations?

* What AI tools would you use in this role, and how?



Applications that do not include the exercise may not be considered.

title: Digital Pet Portrait Artist / Artwork Editor (Photoshop or Procreate) for UK Ecommerce Brand
description:
DIGITAL PET PORTRAIT ARTIST / ARTWORK EDITOR

Remote, Philippines | Full Time, long term

4 positions available. 2 starting immediately, 2 starting September 2026 ahead of Q4 peak season.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are recruiting on behalf of an established UK ecommerce brand creating custom embroidered pet portraits. The brand has been trading since 2020, has produced hundreds of thousands of portraits, and ships to customers across the UK, US, Australia, New Zealand and Europe. Every product starts as a digital illustration of a customer's pet, which is then stitched by an in-house embroidery team in the UK.



The remote artwork team is expanding now and scaling further ahead of the busiest Christmas season to date. Applications are handled through us. Full details of the brand are shared at interview stage.



THE WORK

You will refine pet portrait illustrations so they are a true likeness of each customer's pet and fully optimised for machine embroidery. There are two core workflows:



1. PRE-EDITS (Google Drive workflow)

Work through daily batches of illustrations, comparing each one against the customer's reference photo and editing it before the customer ever sees it. This includes correcting colours, markings and fur patterns, refining eyes, expression and proportions, cropping to a clean face portrait, removing blemishes, and converting blended colours or gradients into solid, embroidery ready colour blocks. The goal is proofs so accurate that customers approve first time with no edits requested.



2. CUSTOMER EDIT ROUNDS (proofing system workflow)

Review customer feedback on proofs inside the proofing system, execute every requested change accurately, upload updated proof files, send the appropriate response templates, and follow the escalation protocols for anything outside standard rules.



Full step by step SOPs, training and screenshot guides are provided for both workflows.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Edit digital pet illustrations to closely match customer reference photos: colours, markings, eyes, ears, noses, expression and facial structure

- Keep all artwork within embroidery constraints: solid colours only, no fine lines, micro details, gradients or blended shading

- Maintain strict consistency with the brand's signature art style

- Work through assigned order batches in a structured, methodical sequence, coordinating daily with the Artwork Manager

- Read and address customer comments fully and accurately using friendly, professional canned responses

- Follow escalation and triage rules precisely (route problem orders rather than guessing)

- Manage file naming, uploads and version control carefully, triple checking every batch before handover

- Communicate proactively via WhatsApp or
 when batches are complete or problems arise



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR (ESSENTIAL)

- Proven digital illustration and editing skills (Photoshop, Procreate, Clip Studio or similar)

- Exceptional attention to detail. This role lives or dies on spotting the difference between a warm brown and a cool brown, or a half pink nose and an all black one

- Ability to accurately replicate an existing art style rather than impose your own

- Strong written English for reading customer feedback and internal communication

- Reliable high speed internet and a computer capable of running professional editing software

- Self motivated and process driven, comfortable following detailed SOPs

- Available full time with working hours that overlap UK business hours for daily coordination



DESIRABLE

- Experience drawing or editing animal or pet portraits

- Experience with print on demand, embroidery digitising, or production constrained artwork

- Previous remote work for UK, US or AU ecommerce brands

- Familiarity with proofing or order management systems



HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED

- First time approval rate, the percentage of your proofs approved by customers without further edit requests. This is the primary KPI

- Edits per order and rework rate

- Daily batch throughput and turnaround time

- Accuracy of file handling and adherence to escalation protocols



WHAT IS ON OFFER

- Full time, stable remote work with a growing international brand. This is not a one off Q4 gig, we are building a long term artwork team

- Complete training, documented SOPs and direct support from the Artwork Manager

- A clear, structured workflow so you focus on the art, not admin chaos



HOW TO APPLY

1. Apply with your CV and portfolio. Your portfolio must include examples of animal or character illustration, ideally showing before and after edits

2. Shortlisted candidates complete a paid test task editing 2 to 3 sample illustrations against reference photos, assessed for accuracy, style match and embroidery readiness

3. Video interview with the Artwork Manager

4. Paid trial batch during your first week with full SOP training



IMPORTANT: In the first line of your application, tell us the name of your own pet or a pet you know well, and the software you use for editing. Applications without this will not be reviewed.

title: REAL ESTATE AGENT VA
description:
Purcell Property is a boutique independent agency operating across the Blue Mountains, an hour and a half west of Sydney, with offices in Leura and Springwood. We sell character homes, architectural houses and village properties in one of the most distinctive residential markets in New South Wales.



We are small, and deliberately so. Every listing is handled properly rather than quickly. Our reputation rests on the quality of what we put in front of vendors and buyers, which means the administration behind a campaign matters as much as the negotiation in front of it.



This is a new role, created because our sales team is spending too many hours on work that should sit with a specialist.



The role



You will run the administrative spine of every sales campaign, from the moment an appraisal is booked through to settlement and beyond. You will work directly with our General Manager and the sales team, and you will own the checklists that keep campaigns moving.



This is not a task-taking role. Within a few months we expect you to be telling us what needs doing, not waiting to be asked.



Pre-listing

Extracting comparable sales from CoreLogic and Pricefinder and building comparable sales schedules

Compiling suburb statistics, days on market and clearance data

Pre-populating our appraisal presentation with comparables and matched buyers before each appointment

Ordering titles, 10.7 planning certificates and sewer diagrams through InfoTrack or GlobalX

Building prospecting lists and preparing mail merges

Campaign launch

Preparing agency agreement packs for licensee review and signature

Booking photography, floor plans, copywriting and styling; managing the supplier calendar

Uploading listings to 
 and Domain, and proofreading every field before it goes live

Briefing brochure, signboard and social artwork

Setting up the campaign in our CRM, including buyer match alerts

Live campaign

Triaging inbound enquiry by
 and SMS, answering factual questions about the property and booking inspections

Setting up open home registrations and running the follow-up sequence

Recording buyer feedback in the CRM within 24 hours of every inspection

Compiling weekly vendor reports with all data and metrics assembled ready for the agent's commentary

Maintaining our anonymised buyer register

Under offer to settlement

Requesting contracts from solicitors and maintaining the contract register

Preparing sales advices and agent's notices

Raising commission invoices and maintaining the settlement diary

Managing review and testimonial requests, database updates and just-sold campaign assets

What this role does not include



We want to be direct about this, because it defines the job.



Australian real estate is a licensed profession and certain functions must be performed by a registered person under supervision in New South Wales. In this role you will not set or comment on price, give property advice, negotiate, convey offers with commentary, make outbound prospecting calls, handle identity verification or anti-money-laundering checks, or have any access to trust accounts.



You prepare, populate, chase, record and format to a very high standard. A licensed team member d
, advises and negotiates. If you are looking for a role that grows into sales, this is not it.



About you



Essential



Two or more years supporting an Australian or New Zealand real estate sales team, either onshore or as a virtual assistant

Working knowledge of an Australian agency CRM — Rex, VaultRE, AgentBox or MyDesktop

Confident with 
 and Domain listing administration

Familiar with the Australian sales cycle: agency agreements, cooling-off periods, planning certificates, vendor disclosure, settlement

Excellent written English. You will draft correspondence that vendors and solicitors read, and it must not need rewriting

Reliable fibre internet with a backup connection, a quiet workspace, and a computer capable of running several applications at once



We will notice



Experience with InfoTrack or GlobalX

Canva, or basic artwork preparation

Experience in a small agency where you were the only administrator



Who does well here



People who chase things without being reminded. People who notice that a floor plan is missing before the campaign goes live rather than after. People who would rather ask a question at 9am than guess and fix it at 4pm.



What we offer

A permanent full-time position with a stable, established agency

13th month pay, paid Philippine public holidays, and paid leave

Genuine hours — we do not expect evenings or weekends

A properly structured onboarding: recorded training for every process, a written 30/60/90 day plan, and a direct reporting line to our General Manager

Annual review, with salary reviewed on performance rather than tenure

How to apply



Send your CV together with a short covering note — no more than 300 words — that answers two things:



Describe the checklist you would work through between a vendor signing an agency agreement and the property going live on 
. Write it as you would actually run it.

Tell us about a time you caught an error before it reached a client.



Please begin your covering note with the word Escarpment so we know you have read the advertisement in full.



Applications without a covering note will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a paid three-hour practical task using a de-identified past listing, and will be paid at the advertised rate for that time.

title: Digital Systems & Automation Specialist
description:
## About the Role



Join **Bravo Migration** as our **Digital Systems & Automation Specialist** and help build, maintain, and improve the technology that supports our growing migration consultancy.



This is a hands-on technical role focused on **WordPress, automation, CRM systems, tracking, integrations, AI-assisted workflow development, and technical troubleshooting**.



This is **not primarily a marketing position**.



We are looking for someone who enjoys working directly inside systems, figuring out how technology fits together, troubleshooting problems, improving workflows, and using AI to solve technical challenges faster.



You do not need to be a software developer or already be an expert in every platform we use. What matters most is that you are technically capable, comfortable learning new systems, and able to investigate problems independently.



## What You'll Do



### Systems & Website Management



* Maintain and update our WordPress websites

* Build and edit pages using **Salient Theme and WPBakery**

* Create and update landing pages

* Manage website forms, links, buttons, plugins, and conversion elements

* Troubleshoot website and plugin issues

* Make basic HTML and CSS adjustments where required

* Maintain integrations between our website and other business systems

* Test changes before they are published

* Help maintain reliable and well-documented digital systems

* Identify opportunities to improve existing processes and systems



Strong hands-on WordPress experience is one of the most important requirements for this role.



### CRM & ActiveCampaign



Manage and improve the systems supporting our customer and lead journeys.



Responsibilities include:



* Build and maintain **ActiveCampaign automations**

* Create triggers, conditions, tags, and custom fields

* Maintain CRM pipelines and deals

* Support lead routing and assignment workflows

* Build follow-up and nurture automations

* Troubleshoot automation issues

* Maintain CRM data accuracy

* Test workflows before deployment

* Identify opportunities to reduce manual work through automation



Experience with ActiveCampaign is highly desirable, although strong experience with another CRM or automation platform may also be considered.



### Automation & AI Workflow Development



Help us increase our use of automation across the business using **n8n and AI tools**.



You will:



* Build and maintain n8n workflows

* Connect different applications and business systems

* Work with webhooks and APIs

* Map and transform data between systems

* Create conditional workflow logic

* Work with JSON

* Troubleshoot failed workflows and integrations

* Test and monitor automations

* Document important workflows

* Identify repetitive processes that can be automated

* Help reduce manual tasks and human error



We actively encourage the use of **AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and similar platforms** as part of the workflow-building and problem-solving process.



You should be comfortable using AI to:



* Design automation workflows

* Generate and troubleshoot workflow logic

* Understand API documentation

* Build API requests

* Work with JSON

* Generate basic JavaScript when required

* Diagnose technical errors

* Research unfamiliar systems

* Create technical documentation

* Find better ways to automate business processes



You do not need to know every answer yourself.



We want someone who knows **how to use AI, documentation, testing, and technical reasoning to find the answer and make the solution work.**



### Tracking & Analytics



Help maintain accurate tracking across our digital platforms.



You will work with systems including:



* Google Tag Manager

* Google Analytics 4

* Google Ads

* Meta Ads

* OpenAI Ads

* WordPress

* Calendly

* ActiveCampaign



Responsibilities include:



* Maintain website and conversion tracking

* Manage and test UTM parameters

* Help maintain advertising attribution

* Configure and troubleshoot conversion events

* Test customer journeys to ensure data is being captured correctly

* Identify where tracking or attribution information is being lost

* Help maintain accurate lead-source information

* Troubleshoot tracking discrepancies between platforms

* Assist with reporting and performance dashboards



You do **not** need to be an advertising campaign manager.



We are primarily interested in your ability to understand and maintain the **technical tracking infrastructure behind our advertising and lead-generation systems**.



### Video Editing



Assist with regular video editing using **CapCut**.



Responsibilities include:



* Edit short-form social media videos

* Cut longer recordings into shorter clips

* Add captions and subtitles

* Remove unwanted sections

* Clean up basic audio

* Add transitions and simple effects

* Resize and format videos for different platforms

* Follow existing templates and brand guidelines



We are not looking for an advanced video producer, but you should be comfortable and efficient using CapCut for everyday editing.



## What We're Looking For



### Essential Experience



* Strong hands-on **WordPress** experience

* Experience editing and maintaining existing WordPress websites

* Strong technical problem-solving ability

* Experience with CRM or automation platforms

* Confidence using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude

* Ability to learn unfamiliar software quickly

* Good understanding of how different digital systems connect

* Strong attention to detail

* Good written English

* Ability to work independently and investigate technical problems



### Strongly Preferred



Experience with several of the following:



* **Salient WordPress Theme**

* **WPBakery**

* **ActiveCampaign**

* **n8n**

* Google Tag Manager

* Google Analytics 4

* Calendly

* CapCut

* APIs

* Webhooks

* JSON

* HTML

* CSS

* Basic JavaScript

* Google Ads conversion tracking

* Meta conversion tracking

* UTM tracking and attribution



### Additional Experience That Would Be Valuable



* Zapier

* Make

* Stripe integrations

* Looker Studio

* Cloudflare

* DNS and domain management

* Google Search Console

* Technical SEO

* Microsoft 365 / Outlook integrations

* Wistia

* AI agents or LLM-powered workflows



You **do not need experience with every platform listed above**.



We would rather hire someone with strong technical ability, curiosity, and problem-solving skills who can quickly learn new systems than someone who simply has a long list of software on their resume.



## Personal Attributes



We are looking for someone who:



* Is technically minded

* Enjoys figuring out why something is not working

* Likes building systems and automating repetitive work

* Uses AI naturally as part of their problem-solving process

* Can research solutions independently

* Is comfortable experimenting and testing

* Understands the importance of data accuracy

* Pays close attention to technical details

* Documents important processes

* Checks that something actually works before considering the task complete

* Takes ownership of problems rather than waiting for step-by-step instructions

* Is excited about learning new technology



A marketing background can be useful, but **technical ability is much more important to us than marketing experience**.



We would prefer a technically strong candidate who needs to learn some of our marketing systems over an experienced marketer who has limited technical capability.



## Your Career Journey



**Starting Point:** Digital Systems & Automation Specialist



As your technical knowledge and understanding of the business develops, there will be opportunities to take greater ownership of automation, systems architecture, AI workflows, tracking, CRM infrastructure, and operational technology.



Potential progression could include:



**Digital Systems & Automation Specialist ? Senior Systems & Automation Specialist ? Digital Operations & Automation Manager**



This role provides exposure to multiple business systems and the opportunity to develop valuable skills in automation, AI, CRM technology, analytics, and digital operations.



## Success Metrics



### First-Year Priorities



Success in this role will include:



* Maintaining reliable WordPress websites and landing pages

* Improving the reliability of ActiveCampaign automations

* Building and deploying new n8n workflows

* Reducing repetitive manual tasks through automation

* Improving tracking and attribution accuracy

* Identifying and resolving technical issues quickly

* Maintaining clear documentation for important workflows

* Becoming increasingly independent across our technology stack



### Long-Term Impact



You will help us:



* Build systems that scale as the business grows

* Reduce manual work and human error

* Improve data accuracy across platforms

* Create more sophisticated AI-assisted workflows

* Improve our ability to understand where leads and clients come from

* Build reliable automation between our business systems

* Continuously improve the technology supporting our team and clients



## Why Bravo Migration



### Technology Forward



We actively invest in automation, AI, CRM technology, analytics, and digital systems. You will have the opportunity to work with a wide range of modern platforms and help shape how we use them.



### Opportunity to Build



You will not simply be maintaining someone else's processes. You will have opportunities to identify problems, recommend improvements, build new workflows, and help create better ways of working.



### Direct Business Impact



The systems you work on directly support our marketing, sales, client experience, and internal operations.



### Continuous Learning



Technology changes quickly, particularly in AI and automation. We want someone who enjoys learning and experimenting with new tools and approaches.



### Career Development



As Bravo Migration grows, there will be opportunities for the right person to take increasing ownership of our automation, systems, data, and digital infrastructure.



## About Bravo Migration



**Bravo Migration** is an Australian migration consultancy helping individuals, families, and businesses navigate Australia's migration system.



Our team combines migration expertise with technology, digital systems, automation, and modern business processes to deliver a professional and efficient experience for our clients.



As we continue to grow, we are investing heavily in improving the systems behind the business—from our websites and CRM to automation, tracking, AI, and operational technology.



We are looking for people who want to grow with us and help build the systems that support the next stage of Bravo Migration.



## Ready to Apply?



If you are the type of person who gets excited about solving technical problems, automating repetitive work, learning new technology, and using AI to build better systems, we would like to hear from you.



When applying, please include:



1. Your experience working with WordPress.

2. Which WordPress themes and page builders you have used.

3. Whether you have experience with Salient or WPBakery.

4. Which CRM platforms you have worked with.

5. Which automation platforms you have used, including n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar.

6. One example of an automation or workflow you have built.

7. An example of how you currently use AI tools in your work.

8. Your experience with Google Tag Manager, GA4, or conversion tracking.

9. Your level of experience with CapCut.

10. An example of a technical problem you had to investigate and solve independently.

title: Video Editor For DTC Brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor – E-commerce



We’re a fast-growing e-commerce company looking for an **experienced Direct Response Video Editor** to join our creative team.



This role is focused on editing 2–3 minute story-driven ads, VSL-style creatives, UGC advertisements, testimonial videos, and longer-form direct-response ads** for platforms such as Meta and TikTok.



We are not looking for someone who only knows how to make videos look visually nice.



We’re looking for an editor who understands storytelling, pacing, retention, emotional buildup, hooks, pattern interrupts, and how video editing contributes to making an ad convert.



### What you'll be editing



Most creatives will be between **1–3+ minutes**, including:



* Story-based advertisements

* VSL-style ads

* UGC direct-response ads

* Customer testimonial creatives

* Problem ? solution advertisements

* Founder/storytelling-style ads

* Longer paid social creatives

* Different hooks and variations of winning ads



You’ll usually receive a script, voiceover, raw footage, UGC clips, product footage, and creative references.



Your job is to turn those assets into a compelling advertisement that keeps people watching.



### What we're looking for



You should already understand the fundamentals of **direct-response and e-commerce advertising**.



You should be comfortable with:



* Editing 2–3 minute ads without losing viewer attention

* Building a strong hook in the first few seconds

* Storytelling and emotional pacing

* Matching visuals closely to the voiceover

* Knowing when to change footage to maintain retention

* Using captions, text overlays, music and sound effects naturally

* Finding relevant supporting footage and B-roll

* Creating pattern interrupts without making the edit feel chaotic

* Editing UGC footage so it still feels authentic

* Creating multiple hook and creative variations

* Following references while still making good creative decisions yourself



Experience with **Meta ads, DTC brands, VSLs, or performance marketing creatives** is strongly preferred.



We do not expect you to know everything, but you should already have a strong editing foundation and understand that **performance matters more than flashy effects.**



### The type of work we like



Think modern direct-response creative from strong DTC advertisers.



Good pacing, clear storytelling, strong hooks, believable UGC, emotional buildup, and edits that support the sales message rather than distract from it.



### Long-term opportunity



This is not a one-off project.



We produce a large amount of advertising creative and are looking for editors who can become a **long-term part of our creative team**.



We value editors who are reliable, communicate well, take feedback seriously, and actively try to understand why certain ads perform better than others.



### How to apply



Please send:



1. **Your portfolio**

2. **2–3 advertisements you personally edited**, ideally longer-form e-commerce ads, VSLs, story ads, or UGC creatives

3. A short explanation of your previous editing experience

4. Your current availability

5. **A 2–3 minute video introduction**



For the introduction video, simply record yourself speaking directly to the camera.



No professional editing is necessary.



Please tell us:



* Who you are

* Where you're based

* How long you've been editing

* What brands or types of videos you've worked on

* Whether you've edited VSLs or direct-response ads before

* What editing software you use

* What you believe makes a 2–3 minute advertisement hold attention

* Why you're interested in this position



**Please do not send a scripted AI-generated introduction. We want to hear from you naturally and understand who you are.**



Applications without a video introduction may not be considered.



We care more about **good judgment, storytelling ability, reliability and understanding performance creative** than having a perfect résumé.

title: Personal Injury Settlement Specialist

As a key member of our Settlements Department, you will own the entire post-settlement process, ensuring cases close efficiently, liens are negotiated strategically, and clients feel supported every step of the way. Client Experience & Communication

Case Closure & Quality Control

• Perform final file audits to ensure all documentation is complete and compliant.

• Conduct file inventories and maintain organized, well-documented records.

What You Bring (Skills & Qualifications)

• Personal injury law firm experience with hands-on involvement in lien negotiations, settlements, or case resolution is highly preferred but not required.

• Exceptional negotiation skills with a results-driven mindset.

• Strong math and financial review skills; comfortable reconciling costs and calculating distributions.

• Superior attention to detail and organizational discipline.

• Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills and a client-service mindset.

• Familiarity with PI case management systems such as SmartAdvocate (or similar) highly preferred but not required.

• Bilingual (English/Spanish or English/Haitian Creole) highly preferred but not required.

Who You Are

You are someone who:

• Takes ownership of a file and sees it through to completion.

title: YouTube Video Editor
description:
Channel Type: Faceless YouTube channel



Commitment: Full-time | 6 days/week | 8 hours/day (prompt responses expected during working hours)



Turnaround: Fast-paced with daily deadlines. Each video must be completed, submitted, and formally approved within the same day. Work is only considered finished once approval is granted and no further revisions are required. If videos are completed and approved ahead of schedule, the workday may conclude early; if approval is not achieved within scheduled hours, continued effort is required until the video is finalized and accepted.



Resources: Detailed VO scripts and reference videos will be provided for every single video



About the Role

We run a fast-growing faceless YouTube channel producing long-form, story-driven content on trending news. Each video is built around a professional voiceover script — your role is to add visual direction and bring it to life.

We're seeking a full-time video editor to independently source footage, craft engaging edits, and design high-impact thumbnails — all to a consistent daily standard. This is a long-term position with stable pay and strong growth potential.



What You'll Do



Edit 2 long-form videos daily (25-35 minutes each), synced precisely to provided voiceover scripts with a polished, broadcast-quality finish



Independently research, source, and organize a high volume of B-roll and footage (dozens to hundreds of clips per video).

Every single clip must be directly relevant to what the narrator is saying at that exact moment. No generic filler, no lazy stock footage. Public event clips, news interviews, archival material, paparazzi footage, and royalty-free assets must all be hunted down with patience, precision, and a researcher's mindset



Match footage tightly to the narration — when the script references a specific person, event, or moment, the visual on screen must reflect it. Viewers should feel the video was made for that story, not assembled from whatever was available

Keep engagement high with varied visuals — mix close-ups, reaction clips, text overlays, and relevant cutaways to prevent drop-off across the full 25–35 minute runtime



Add professional finishing elements: on-screen subtitles/captions, smooth transitions, background music, and cinematic pacing tuned for retention



Design 2 CTR-focused thumbnails daily — bold, emotionally charged, YouTube-native style with strong visual hierarchy

Maintain an organized shared asset library and meet all daily deadlines without follow-up

What You Need



Proven proficiency in Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or DaVinci Resolve



Strong thumbnail design skills using Photoshop or Canva



Strong research ability — patience to source precise and relevant footage for 25–35 minute scripts (finding the exact clip, not just a close enough one)



High attention to detail — visuals must match narration exactly. (e.g. If the narrator says "the garden party in 2018," the footage on screen should reflect that moment specifically, not a random garden party



B-roll sourcing experience — from stock libraries, YouTube archives, and public media

A reliable workstation with capable setup and fast internet for long form projects



Good English comprehension — all scripts and voiceovers are in English

A sharp sense of storytelling, pacing, and audience retention for news-style content



Judgement on footage — knowing when clips add emotional weight vs. noise



Full-time commitment — 6 days/week and 8 hours per day, delivering 2 complete videos + 2 thumbnails daily. Prompt responses expected during working hours.



Bonus Points

Previous experience editing news, current events, or royal/celebrity content

Familiarity with royalty-free asset platforms (Storyblocks, Pexels, Artgrid, etc.) and basic audio mixing

Understanding of YouTube CTR and retention best practices (hooks, pacing, visual variety)

Experience editing long-form content where viewer retention past the 50% mark is a real priority



How to Apply

Message me directly here, or
 with the subject line: YouTube Editor Application – [Your Name]

Please include:

Two examples of long-form videos you have edited (links preferred)

Two YouTube-style thumbnails you have designed

Your editing and design tools (software + hardware specs)

Your availability — earliest start date and preferred 8-hours working schedule

title: QA Tester (Web + Backend) - Contract with Long-Term Potential
description:
We are a casino and gaming-focused web platform preparing to launch. 



We need a meticulous QA Tester to tear apart our product before it goes live. This is not a "click around and see if it looks okay" job. This is a deep, systematic hunt for broken buttons, dead links, modal failures, popup glitches, flow interruptions, backend-to-frontend communication breaks, and anything else that would make a real user lose trust in the product.



You will be testing three surfaces:



1. A pre-registration landing page (where users sign up before launch)

2. The main web application and its game lobby

3. An internal backoffice dashboard (admin tooling, CRM-adjacent systems)



For each surface, you are expected to test:

- Every button, link, and interactive element

- Every modal, popup, tooltip, and notification

- Every form, input, validation, and error state

- Complete user flows from start to finish (registration, navigation, game access, admin operations)

- Front-end to back-end communication (does the action you took actually do what it should server-side)

- Edge cases: mobile, desktop, different browsers, slow connections, broken states

- Anything that connects to or should feed into our CRM pipeline



Your primary output is structured QA reports. Each report should include:



- Clear title for each issue

- Steps to reproduce (numbered, exact)

- Expected behavior vs. actual behavior

- Screenshots or screen recordings where applicable

- Severity rating (Critical, High, Medium, Low)

- Environment details (browser, device, OS)



What We Need From You to Apply:



1. A short written introduction  explaining who you are and what kind of QA work you have done. Write this yourself. Do not paste a generated summary. If your introduction reads like it was written as AI SLOP, we will not read further.



2. A sample QA report from a previous project. This should be a real report you wrote for a real testing engagement, not a template. If you do not have a prior report, write one against any public website of your choice (pick one, test it for 15 minutes, and document what you find).



3. State your English fluency level explicitly (C1, C2, or Native).



What Gets You Disqualified Immediately:

- AI-generated applications. If your writing has the hallmarks of AI-generated text (generic filler, robotic phrasing, overuse of certain punctuation patterns), we stop reading. Write like a human.

- Applications with no sample report attached.

- Applications that do not state an English level.



About the Role:

This is a 4 to 6 week intensive contract with the strong possibility of ongoing work after launch. You will be added to our Slack workspace and work alongside the team directly. We want someone who can integrate, communicate, and flag problems without needing to be chased. If the engagement goes well, there is a clear path to an ongoing QA relationship as the product scales.



Skills Required:

- Manual QA testing (web applications)

- Bug report writing (structured, reproducible)

- Cross-browser testing

- Mobile web testing

- Basic understanding of front-end to back-end data flow

- Experience with any issue tracking tool (Jira, Linear, GitHub Issues, or similar)
